𝗝𝗔𝗡𝗦𝗘𝗡 𝗧𝗢𝗨𝗖𝗛𝗘𝗦 𝟭𝟬𝟬! 🇿🇦

Marco Jansen's 100th Test wicket came as he removed Renshaw (74) and Green (65) in Cape Town.

Aus 191/4 at tea, SA 329 🔥

#Cricket #SAvAUS

👉 Cape Town Test Day 2 mein Marco Jansen ne 100th Test wicket liya
👉 Renshaw (74) aur Green (65) dono Jansen ke shikaar
👉 Australia 191/4 at tea, South Africa ka total 329
👉 Series 1-1, yeh decider hai
